<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2018 Gaza border protests]]
**[[Israel]]i troops shoot dead ten [[Palestinians]] near the [[Israel–Gaza barrier]], including a Palestinian journalist, as protests continue. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-43667947 (BBC)]<!--Not sure, but per Times of Israel source below seems this was yesterday?-->
**A funeral is held for journalist [[Yasser Murtaja]], shot at the fence wearing a press jacket covering tyre burnings by protestors yesterday. Israel denies targeting journalists intentionally and says it is investigating. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/apr/07/hundreds-funeral-palestinian-journalist-gaza (''The Guardian'')]
**Israeli Prime Minister [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] and Defence Minister [[Avigdor Liberman]] both praise the military response, with Liberman accusing Murtaja of "putting himself in danger" by operating a drone. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liberman-israels-preparation-on-the-gaza-border-proved-itself/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*[[2018 Münster vehicle ramming]]
**A man [[vehicle-ramming attack|drives a van]] into a group of people in [[Münster]], [[Germany]], killing two and injuring 30. The driver then shoots and kills himself. [https://www.express.co.uk/news/world/942757/Germany-news-Cottbus-van-attack-police-alert (''Express'')] [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/04/07/europe/germany-muenster-crash/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Terrorism in India]]
**Local authorities in [[Goa]], [[India]], issue a terror alert for the West Coast for fishing vessels, resorts, barges, and offshore casinos. The alert states a fishing vessel may be used to launch a terrorist attack. The Ports Minister states that [[Pakistan]] has seized an Indian fishing vessel in connection with the alleged plot. [http://www.financialexpress.com/india-news/goa-government-issues-alert-after-intel-on-possible-terror-attack-10-developments/1124751/ (''The Financial Express'')]
*[[Terrorism in the United Kingdom]]
**[[Metropolitan Police]] arrest a [[terrorism Acts|suspected terrorist]] at [[Gatwick Airport]] after he arrives on a flight from [[Morocco]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-43680838 (BBC)]
*[[Cyberattack]]s on [[Iran]]
**The [[Ministry of Information and Communications Technology of Iran]] says hackers attacked its networks, leaving an image of US flags on screens. A researcher at [[Cisco Systems|Cisco]]'s Talos security group acknowledges "several incidents in multiple countries" involving the use of their ''Smart Install'' protocol. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-cyber-hackers/iran-hit-by-global-cyber-attack-that-left-u-s-flag-on-screens-idUSKBN1HE0MH (Reuters)]
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**[[2018 Douma chemical weapons attack]]
***Dozens of people in the [[Syria]]n city of [[Douma, Syria|Douma]] are reported killed in an apparent [[chemical weapons]] attack. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/dozens-killed-in-apparent-chemical-weapons-attack-on-civilians-in-eastern-ghouta--rescue-workers/2018/04/08/231bba18-3ac0-11e8-af3c-2123715f78df_story.html?utm_term=.dc69bf799a2b (''The Washington Post'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*A fire breaks out at the 50th floor of the [[New York City|New York]] [[Trump Tower]], killing one resident and injuring four firefighters. According to the [[New York City Fire Department]], the building had no sprinklers. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-43686271 (BBC)] [https://www.smh.com.au/world/north-america/fire-at-trump-tower-in-new-york-20180408-p4z8d5.html (''The Sydney Morning Herald'')]
*A military helicopter crashes in [[Fort Campbell]], [[Kentucky]], [[United States]] kills both pilots. [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/04/08/politics/army-soldiers-identified-helicopter-crash/index.html (CNN)]
*[[List of shipwrecks in 2018]]
**MV ''Vitaspirit'', a 225-meter cargo ship, crashes into a 200-year-old historic coastal mansion on the outskirts of [[Istanbul]], [[Turkey]] after an engine failure during a voyage from [[Russia]] to [[Saudi Arabia]]. [http://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/ship-that-crashed-into-istanbul-waterfront-mansion-moored-in-marmara-sea-129961 (''Hurriyet Daily News'')]

;International relations
*[[2018 North Korea–United States summit]]
**Several administration officials say the governments of the [[United States]] and [[North Korea]] have begun secret, direct talks with each other. [http://www.cnn.com/2018/04/07/politics/north-korea-us-talks/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Japan]] activates a 2,100-member [[Amphibious Rapid Deployment Brigade]], its first [[Marines|marine]] force since [[World War II]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-japan-defence-marines/japan-activates-first-marines-since-ww2-to-bolster-defenses-against-china-idUSKCN1HE069 (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*Former [[Brazil]]ian [[President of Brazil|President]] [[Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva]] gives a public address alongside his impeached successor [[Dilma Rousseff]] in [[São Bernardo do Campo]], saying he will comply with an arrest warrant and begin a 12-year term for corruption after two failed appeals to have the warrant withdrawn. He maintains his innocence. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-43684332 (BBC)]
*[[Terrorism in Iraq]]
**[[Iraq]]i security services announce the arrests of 20 suspected [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|Islamic State]] militants in raids in [[Nineveh]]. [https://www.iraqinews.com/iraq-war/over-20-islamic-state-members-arrested-in-several-security-operations-in-nineveh/ (Iraq News)]

;Politics and elections
* Brenna Spencer, a female supporter of [[Donald Trump]], goes viral after carrying a handgun in her pants while taking a photo. [https://uk.news.yahoo.com/female-trump-supporter-apos-gun-165753131.html (Yahoo! News)]

;Sport
*[[2017–18 Bundesliga]]
**[[association football|Football]] team [[FC Bayern Munich]] win the competition. It is their sixth title in a row and their 28th [[German football league system|German]] [[List of German football champions|title]] overall. [https://au.sports.yahoo.com/league/a/39768046/bayern-keep-title-celebrations-in-check-to-focus-on-europe/ (AFP via Yahoo! Sport)]
